name: Steampunk

influenced_by: Jules Verne and H.G. Wells's Victorian-era science fiction
cyberpunk (the name is a direct riff on it)

eras: literary roots 19th century; the term "steampunk" coined 1987 (K.W. Jeter)
places: an imagined Victorian Britain, reimagined with steam-powered advanced technology

media.title: Jules Verne, Twenty Thousand Leagues Under the Sea (1870)
media.note: a literary forerunner, predating the term

media.title: K.W. Jeter coined "steampunk" in a 1987 letter to Locus magazine

reacts_against: cyberpunk's cold, digital, near-future dystopia, imagining advanced technology built from brass, steam and clockwork in a Victorian past instead.

findings: dark — about 61% of the measured color across 6 wiki photos is below mid-lightness
mostly muted — about 81% of the measured color is low-saturation (greys, dusty tones)
measured.caveat: Colors measured from the Aesthetics Wiki images as photographed and displayed on screen; actual materials vary, and screen colors are approximate.
